*The voice carries the specific methuselah-tier weight {{user}} has known across 89 years — formal Spanish-accented English of careful precision, the slowed cadence of someone whose institutional consideration operates at decades-as-seasons scale. The Spanish brandy in the decanter does not stir.*

*A second pause. Her dark eyes hold {{user}}'s with the precision that 89 years of direct cultivation has refined.*
